body:
Worker 1's full-shard evidence at `1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5` assigns `IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-1` through `IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-12` to #1159 in `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/final-188-scientific-review-v1.json`. Its active shard report repeats that attribution. The live #1159 body covers only the three earlier canary findings (`IR-DRAFT-1`, `IR-DRAFT-2`, `IR-VALIDATION-1`) and has no comments expanding its scope.

This issue records the distinct full-shard finding set and the publication provenance correction `W01-PUBLISHED-001`. Preserve #1159's canary identity. The full-shard review reports these corrections in isolated proposals, independently re-reviewed before publication:

| Finding | Defect and corrected scope |
| --- | --- |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-1 | Distinguish the unsuccessful JCM956 retrieval from the explicit JCM574 fallback and actual MDS context. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-2 | Remove the false discrepancy between frozen `10 MILLIMOLAR` and `10 mM` for case105; retain the actual reagent-form uncertainty. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-3 | Correct named case104's receiving dose from 1 to 2 mL. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-4 | Distinguish case138's current recipe1188 direct reference to852 from the frozen1187 inheritance narrative. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-5 | Correct case103's receiving dose from 5 to10 mL. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-6 | Correct case112's receiving dose from 1 to1.5 mL. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-7 | Remove root40's unsupported aqueous assertion; retain the actual solvent evidence gap. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-8 | Keep Middlebrook7H10 dry base distinct from the NCIT enriched finished medium. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-9 | Retire source-local/generic aliases that would resolve globally, including bare numbered pointers; qualify the JCM431 stock name and mapping label. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-10 | Reconcile four duplicate proposal families while preserving each source-case/occurrence lineage. The NBRC1257/1321 bicarbonate and sulfide pairs are also tracked by #1166; NBRC1339 phenanthrene and NBRC943 Metal44 are the other two families. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-11 | Preserve added-water quantities without treating them as final solution volumes or inferred final concentrations; retain explicit preparation and comparison bases. |
| IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT-12 | Correct false or unrelated missing-evidence requirements for cases38/64 and34/59/66, preserving the source-supported remaining gaps. |

The separate coordinator findings remain on #1163, #1164, #1166, #1167 and #1168. This tracker does not replace them or grant maintained-record, mapping, role, component or release approval.

Append an immutable provenance correction or successor, update active report/issue references and the PR description, and preserve old primary captures, proposal payloads, native saved reviews and canary files byte-for-byte. Do not rewrite the historical review merely to conceal its mistaken issue reference. The published correction must bind the exact prior review hash and all twelve finding IDs. Obtain independent final-head re-review of the new references and confirm the scientific payloads are unchanged.

Independent evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/w01-published-head-review-v1/finding-001-tracker-scope.json`; prior full-shard review SHA256 `02b2be72b448d35b573ad992a3d2c98afcd3f16430709e10d6837564b595edcf`; active report SHA256 `762ba8d961cfdfc856c724d2a4b232cc776bbc43861e34a0f7d28af70b06f1df`. A live all-state GitHub issue search for `IR-SHARD-ARTIFACT` found no existing dedicated tracker. The local evidence search included ignored files. No scientific payload defect was found in the independent 188-case/76-proposal reassessment.
